description:
List all available AQUAVIEW data collections (sources).

Returns a summary of each collection with ID, title, description, spatial/temporal extent, and keywords. Use collection IDs to filter searches.

These are CATALOG collections. Several are also queryable row by row — see
list_data_sources for the sources get_data can pull observations from.

A collection's bbox and temporal range are OUTER BOUNDS, not a promise of
coverage. They are the envelope around everything in the collection, so
most of the box usually holds no data at all — an Argo collection spans
the global ocean, a partner collection with one point either side of the
date line spans the whole planet. An empty result for a point or window
inside the extent is the normal answer, not a failure: report "no data
there", not "the query did not work", and do not widen a search on the
strength of a bbox alone.

Args:
    tag: Only collections with this tag, e.g. "uxs" for uncrewed systems. Pass the returned IDs as `collections` to search_datasets to search only those.
    output_format: "csv" (default, sectioned CSV — ~20% fewer tokens than TOON for this tabular response), "json", or "toon". Use "json" for deterministic/structured consumers.

Returns:
    List of collections with count. CSV mode emits a single `## collections`
    section with columns id,title,bbox,temporal,keywords,description;
    bbox is rendered as "west,south,east,north"; temporal as "min|max";
    keywords ";"-joined.
name: list_collections
